content.title: "Tons of Interest" in eVTOL Space, Says Archer Aviation CEO
content.description:
Archer Aviation is designing and developing electric vertical take-off and landing aircrafts (eVTOL) for use in urban air mobility networks. Chairman and CEO Adam Goldstein believes that by next June there will be aircrafts flying 'in and around several big urban cities." Goldstein explains that Archer is operating with both an international and domestic strategy within its civil business arm, including working closely with the UAE government.
He joined Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec on 'Bloomberg Businessweek Daily' to discuss upcoming earnings report, commercial operations, and the eVTOL market.
